clauses.evidence: Neither party's aggregate liability arising out of or related to this Agreement will exceed the total amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement during the twelve (12) month period preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
clauses.explanation: Mutual cap at 12 months' fees, as in the standard.

judge.reason: The explanation names the concrete equivalence points (mutual cap, 12 months' fees), and both are directly supported by Section 6 of the vendor text and the standard clause, with nothing invented.

clauses.evidence: Provider will notify Customer in writing no less than sixty (60) days prior to each renewal date, and Customer may elect not to renew by giving written notice at any time before the renewal date.
clauses.explanation: One-year renewals, 60-day notice, cancel before renewal.

judge.reason: The explanation names the concrete equivalent points (one-year renewals, 60-day vendor notice, customer cancellation any time before renewal), all of which appear in both the vendor Section 3 and the standard clause.

clauses.evidence: Customer will pay each undisputed invoice within forty-five (45) days after receipt. Overdue amounts may accrue interest at the lesser of 1% per month or the maximum rate permitted by law.
clauses.explanation: Net 45 from receipt; interest capped at 1% monthly.

judge.reason: The explanation states the concrete equivalent terms (net 45 from receipt, interest capped at 1% per month), both of which are supported by the vendor text and the standard clause, with no invented claims.

clauses.evidence: Customer may terminate this Agreement for any reason upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice. Upon such termination, Provider will refund any prepaid fees covering the remainder of the term
clauses.explanation: 30 days' notice with refund of prepaid fees after termination.

judge.reason: The explanation names the concrete equivalence points (30 days' notice and refund of prepaid fees after termination), and both are supported by Section 4 of the vendor text and the standard clause without adding anything unsupported.

judge.reason: It names the concrete terms (one-month vendor cap and uncapped customer liability, versus a mutual 12-month cap in the standard), and both claims, plus the amendment overriding the main agreement, are supported by the amendment text.
